recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate `Relic of the Hollow Grove` as a single-file mobile-first browser game: a mythic Zelda-like forest shrine boss adventure that preserves the source mechanics exactly. The player is an Emerald Relic-Knight in a top-down canvas arena. They move with a left virtual joystick, open a sealed gate with a right-side action button, then fight the Hollow Wyrm-Knight using a sword attack and timed shield parry. Preserve the original HP values, boss HP, attack range/damage cadence, parry active frames and cooldown, boss chase/slash/projectile states, projectile collision, obstacle collision, summon delay, victory, defeat, and restart semantics.

Transform presentation aggressively but safely: use an ancient grove/dungeon setting, mossy ruins, golden rune grids, forest wisps, triangular relic glyphs, heart-based HUD language, Guardian Seal boss bar, large portrait-safe controls, Cinzel fantasy title typography, compact GIF feedback, and approved catalog forest audio. The final game should be readable and playable in portrait mobile viewports from 4:7 to 9:16 and should feel like an authored public-facing fantasy shrine quest rather than a cyber boss prototype.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Game Reality
- genre: Mobile-first top-down canvas action boss encounter with a short roam/setup phase.
- objective: Start in roaming space, use the summon/gate button, survive the boss, reduce boss HP to zero with sword attacks, and avoid losing all player HP.
- input model: Touch joystick for movement; touch/click action buttons for summon, attack, and parry; keyboard movement was not implemented in the source.
- core loop: Move around a procedurally populated arena, trigger boss arrival, close distance to attack, time parries against melee/projectile damage, monitor HP and boss HP, restart on win or loss.
- fail/friction state: Player HP reaches zero from boss slash/projectile hits; collision against arena blocks prevents movement through obstacles; attack only lands within range.

## Protected Mechanics
- Preserve joystick movement speed, parry immobility, attack cooldown/timer, parry active frames and cooldown, boss chase/slash/projectile behavior, HP totals, boss HP/damage ranges, win/loss/restart semantics, collision against rectangular obstacles, summon delay, and canvas update loop semantics.

## Safe Transformation Surfaces
HUD language, title/copy, canvas drawings, palette, background motifs, obstacle shapes, NPC/ambient sprites, summon portal visuals, particles, font choices, SFX URL choices from approved catalogs, GIF feedback choices, button styling, and world/progression framing are safe to transform because they do not alter gameplay rules.
